registered: before SCIENCE_LOCK and before any calibration fit or Adult label read
status: forecasts only: they never determine execution, gates or labels
basis: lra: the kappa-32 learned decoder fitted on the teacher's own fitting rows improved fitting-row occupation LL by about 0.026 nats but worsened held-out occupation LL on every named same-token map (+0.010 / +0.024)

admission: the occupation recipient has about 230-270 tokens per map, so 2,000 calibration representatives give about 7-9 rows per occupation token (income: about 14-16 tokens, about 130-140 rows per token); the kappa-32 prior (32 pseudo-observations) therefore dominates most occupation tokens

the frozen U heads were fitted (and the teacher means computed) on OSF_DEFENSE_FIT; mean decoding pools teacher probabilities within a token, so q0 is the in-sample average of teacher outputs, whose held-out confidence error is unknown
temperature scaling is a low-variance one-parameter recalibration (Guo et al. 2017) that cannot change decisions
the common attack bank now takes, per partition, the maximum over the admitted legacy D0/D1 banks and one fresh bank; recovery can only stay equal or rise relative to the lra D0-only inner values
lra's P* (D0 JOINT lambda 0.1) failed only on occupation LL precision (excess 0.0081, UB 0.0121); calibration of both P* and U may move both sides of that comparison

forecasts.question: Fitting role (D01-D04, JOINT lambda 0.1): sign of T-TOKEN32 minus H-TOKEN32

forecasts.question: Parameter sharing (D05-D08, JOINT lambda 0.1): sign of H-TOKEN32 minus H-GLOBAL-TEMP
forecasts.forecast: shared temperature at least as good on occupation LL (positive point); income near zero

forecasts.question: Ucal*
forecasts.forecast: a temperature family (global or class) beats U identity on inner summed NLL by a small margin

forecasts.question: Nomination
forecasts.forecast: an eligible competitive P* exists, most likely a legacy JOINT/SEQ map at lambda 0.08-0.1 with a held-out temperature decoder or its original D0

forecasts.forecast: the held-out hypothesis is plausible but unproved; the calibrated task-only controls and calibrated U may improve as much as the private arm, so the calibration-matched clauses may remove any original-criterion pass
